## For Brands & Sellers: Mastering TikTok Shop Promotions for Revenue Growth


### Why Smart Promotions Drive Sales and Brand Loyalty


Set a defined goal, such as clearing seasonal inventory, increasing average order value, launching a product, or converting viewers from LIVE. A broad discount may create orders while weakening margin. A targeted coupon tied to a product, basket threshold, or creator campaign gives better control over customer acquisition cost and contribution margin.


Clear terms show qualifying items, expiration, and savings before payment, reducing confusion and support requests. Track redemption, conversion, refunds, repeat purchases, and net revenue rather than order volume alone.


### Setting Up Effective Seller-Funded Coupons and Vouchers


Build the offer in Seller Center around one objective. Select listings, define the budget, set minimum order value, and establish a redemption limit that protects inventory and margin. A percentage discount supports catalog discovery; a fixed-dollar coupon may be easier to understand. Product or basket restrictions can guide buyers toward a profitable order size.


Test the customer experience before launch. Confirm that the coupon appears on the intended product page, applies to the correct variant, and remains valid after shipping and tax calculations. Keep seller-funded savings distinct from platform-supported vouchers in reporting.


### Understanding Payouts and Algorithm Subsidies


Review the *what you earned* payout breakdown in Seller Center after orders process. Distinguish item revenue, seller-funded discounts, platform subsidies, fees, shipping adjustments, refunds, and other deductions. Platform support may reduce the customer’s price without placing the entire discount burden on the seller, subject to campaign terms.


Estimate profitability from settled payouts, canceled orders, returns, and affiliate commissions, not storefront price alone. Maintain accurate product information, use approved campaign settings, and retain transaction records if an order is flagged.


### Leveraging Creator Partnerships for Discount Campaigns


Creator promotions work best when product, audience, offer, and content format align. Give partners a landing product, commission structure, campaign window, talking points, and disclosure guidance. A creator-specific coupon or affiliate link makes attribution easier. Monitor clicks, attributed orders, conversion, refunds, and revenue by creator.
